meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 vercel CLI 把你的 web 应用部署到 Vercel(生产或预览),也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。它先跑本地构建,确认部署状态为 READY、线上 URL 返回 2xx,才把地址给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署或发布一个 web 应用,或要管理 Vercel 项目、域名等资源时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我最近的 Vercel 部署
say.note: 执行 vercel ls 返回最近部署

say.text: 把 DATABASE_URL 加进 Vercel 生产环境变量
say.note: 用管道执行 vercel env add

howto.what_en: Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy your web app to Vercel (production or preview) and manage projects, domains, and env vars. It builds locally first, then checks status is READY and the live URL returns 2xx before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs local build, then vercel deploy --prod

say_en.text: Add DATABASE_URL to Vercel production env vars
say_en.note: Pipes the value into vercel env add
